jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Junior Technology Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Technology Manager by gathering, structuring, and maintaining technology scouting intelligence across emerging technologies, startups, research developments, market signals, and innovation ecosystems relevant to Grid Technologies. Your typical day will involve monitoring technology domains, conducting desk research, and preparing technology opportunity profiles. You will play a key role in ensuring that external signals are captured consistently and translated into clear inputs for further assessment, contributing to the PRM Technology Radar and other analytical activities.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Monitor selected technology domains, startups, research institutions, publications, and market developments relevant to Grid Technologies
* Capture early technology signals and maintain structured scouting inputs across H1–H4 horizons
* Maintain and update Technology Radar entries, ensuring consistent documentation of technology signals and assessment status
* Support preparation for interactions with startups, universities, and research institutes, including background notes and technology summaries
* Maintain scouting records and briefing materials in the central repository, preparing concise summaries and visual inputs for technology briefings
* Use digital and AI-enabled tools to improve searchability, synthesis, and reuse of technology intelligence

What You Bring

* Relevant bachelor’s degree or diploma in engineering, technology management, business, innovation management, data analytics, or a related field
* First experiences in technology scouting, research, strategy, innovation, R&D, consulting, or market intelligence
* Very good understanding of research and the technology of Siemens Energy, with a willingness to learn more
* Curiosity for emerging technologies, energy systems, grid technologies, startups, and innovation ecosystems
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure information and summarize complex topics clearly
* Fluent in English, with good communication skills and attention to detail

jobs.occupation: Senior System Specialist (w/m/d) Simatic S7 & Desigo CC (Ingenieur/in - Automatisierungstechnik)
jobs.description:
Change the world of tomorrow with us.

Based on our management platform Desigo CC and in combination with SIMATIC S7 / TIA Portal, you develop complex solutions for our industrial customers in the field of building automation.
What we offer you

- Mobile working as a global standard- Attractive compensation package- Development opportunities for both your professional and personal growth- A work environment where you can bring your whole self and feel part of Siemens- 30 days of vacation plus a variety of flexible working time models that allow time off for you and your family- Access to employee stock plans

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by

- You not only evaluate different solution concepts but also define the scope of delivery.- By programming innovative solutions in the fields of automation technology / energy management / industrial building automation that meet both customer and market requirements, you show what you're made of.- You coordinate and develop applications with internal and external development departments based on the TIA Portal, complementing the Desigo CC building management platform.- You actively help shape how Artificial Intelligence (AI) supports our engineering – from automated code generation to technical documentation and system comparisons.- You can independently familiarize yourself with new topics and test them on your own.- In doing so, you work with international colleagues from various locations.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You hold a completed degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable field.- Experience & Skills:- You have solid programming skills in SCL, CFC, and STL (AWL), as well as confident handling of SIMATIC Manager and the TIA Portal; knowledge of the technology objects/tools is a plus.- You are familiar with the common protocols used in automation technology – namely Profinet, Modbus, Profibus, and OPC UA.- You are experienced in programming various modules of the Simatic S7 family (S7-1500/1200, as well as S7-300/400).- Knowledge of industrial HVAC applications is a plus, but not a requirement.- Knowledge of Desigo PX products is a plus.- Management systems or SCADA systems (e.g. WinCC) are also part of your repertoire.
- Languages: Through your work in cross-country, multicultural teams, you can demonstrate both your German and English language skills.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
Are you ready to transform the everyday?
At Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings, we are tackling the challenge of making buildings smarter, safer, and more sustainable. Join our team to develop innovative solutions in building automation, fire protection, and security. Here, you can apply your expertise to create sustainable, cutting-edge products that shape the future for our customers. Transform the everyday with us!

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Technology Scouting & Innovation Manager (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Grid Technologies. Your typical day will involve systematically identifying emerging technologies, monitoring market disruptions, and analyzing startup activities. You will serve as the organization’s “early warning and opportunity detection system,” translating external technology signals into actionable insights that inform strategy, portfolio steering, and investment decisions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and maintain a structured technology scouting process across H1–H4 horizons
* Identify emerging technologies with potential impact on Grid Technologies
* Own and continuously update the PRM Technology Radar and create strategic heatmaps of technology opportunities and threats
* Maintain visibility of startup, university, and research ecosystems to support partnership and investment opportunities
* Establish and maintain a central technology knowledge repository to ensure effective dissemination of insights
* Produce actionable intelligence reports for leadership teams and convert technology signals into portfolio recommendations

What You Bring

* Relevant and applicable bachelor’s degree/diploma
* Long-term experience in technology development and Ventures/M&A type projects
* Strong technical focus with a solid understanding of what Siemens Energy does, though not necessarily an expert in specific technologies
* Experience in innovation projects involving universities, research facilities, or similar environments
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills in global matrix organizations, with the ability to translate external signals into clear portfolio and roadmap insights
* Fluent in English

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: System Safety Engineer (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

System Safety Engineer (d/f/m)

to support the Aircraft Development Safety Manching team. You will ensure that Airbus products are developed, designed, produced and supported according to the state-of-art and the relevant safety standards (associated to airworthiness regulations). Safety of the vehicle is maintained throughout its whole lifecycle, considering Human Factors and operation.

You are interested in assessing complex functions through Aircrafts and Systems, analyse the propagation of mechanical or electrical/electronical malfunctions and unintended human operation throughout the system with regards to hazardous Aircraft reaction.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, subsidies for public transport, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria, kindergarten close to the site
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead and conduct main Safety assessments (Functional Hazard Assessment/System Safety Assessment) activities for military aircraft and systems, supporting the phases until certification
- Lead and conduct Risk Analyses, according to the applicable guidance and standards, which are required to support the continuous aircraft development (including Permit to Fly/Type Certificate)
- Lead and conduct Common-Cause Analyses (Particular Risk Analysis, Zonal Safety Analysis and Common Mode Analysis)
- Lead, manage and generate safety requirements, safety evidences (tests, simulation, analyses), Safety Procedures and Limitations, interface with other technical domains (processes, maintenance, human factors, aircraft performance and quality, etc.)
- Strong influence on aircraft/systems architecture development according to the required Safety/Integrity
- Act as interface at the required level with internal and external stake holders (Chief Engineering, Project Management, Design Teams, Airworthiness Authorities, Industrial Partners, Customers, Suppliers)
- Review, approval and application of supplier data regarding Safety and Reliability

Desired skills and qualifications

- Bachelor or Master degree of Aerospace Engineering, Physical Science or similar discipline
- Minimum 3 years working experience in related engineering field
- Knowledge/understanding of Aircraft systems
- System Safety Assessment experience would be an advantage, at least System Engineering experience with interface to Safety Assessment/Airworthiness/Certification
- advanced skills with MS Office are presumed
- Good communication skills and strong problem-solving capability are desirable
- Experience with Safety Tools (e.g. Isograph FaultTree+, Reliability Workbench)
- Very good English language skills, German language is desirable

This position will require a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student for the Hector-Center, Medical Clinic 1, (m/f/d) (Assistent/in - klinische Studien)
jobs.description:
The Hector-Center for Nutrition, Exercise and Sports, Medical Clinic 1, conducts clinical and experimental research in the fields of cancer, obesity, food intolerances, and microbiota. Our translational research projects aim to better understand disease mechanisms and ultimately improve patient care and therapeutic strategies.
A major focus of our research is cancer cachexia, a complex metabolic syndrome that significantly contributes to loss of skeletal muscle and adipose tissue, impaired physical function, reduced quality of life, and poor clinical outcomes in patients with cancer.
Within this research area, we investigate the interactions between cancer cells, skeletal muscle, adipose tissue, and immune cells, with a particular focus on the molecular and immunological mechanisms underlying cancer-associated tissue wasting.

Die Aufgaben

To strengthen our research team, we are looking for an excellent and highly motivated PhD student with a strong interest in cancer biology, metabolism, immunology, and/or molecular medicine.
Depending on the specific research focus, the work will involve:

- in vitro studies with cancer and muscle cells as well as immune cell models and analysis of tissue samples
- contribution to in vivo studies with mice
- preparation of scientific manuscripts and the PhD thesis

Das Know-how dafür

- Master’s degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Medicine, Biotechnology, or a related field
- solid knowledge of cellular and molecular biology
- practical experience with cell culture and molecular biology techniques
- ability to work independently, systematically, and reliably
- strong scientific curiosity and willingness to develop new experimental approaches
- ability to analyze and critically interpret scientific data
- excellent communication and teamwork skills
- good written and spoken English

Zusätzlich von Vorteil

- experience with cancer, skeletal muscle, adipocyte, or immune cell models
- experience with molecular biology techniques such as qPCR, Western blotting, immunofluorescence, or flow cytometry
- FELASA B certificate is advantageous but not mandatory

We are looking for a motivated scientist who is enthusiastic about understanding the mechanisms of cancer-associated wasting and developing new approaches to preserve tissue function and improve outcomes in patients with cancer.

Das bieten wir:

- salary according to E13 TV-L, 65%
- the position is intended to lead to a PhD
- an interdisciplinary and collaborative research environment
- access to modern laboratory infrastructure and established experimental models
- opportunities for scientific training, conference participation, and publication
- close supervision and support throughout the PhD project

Ansprechperson bei Fragen:

Dr. Walburga Dieterich/ Dr. Ü. Korkmaz
Research laboratory of Hector-Center
Telefon: 09131 85-45046

Bewerbung an:

Universitätsklinikum Erlangen
Hector-Center for Nutrition, Excercise and Sports
Dr. Walburga Dieterich
Ulmenweg 18
91054 Erlangen

jobs.occupation: Senior Researcher in Embedded Research for SAP Autonomous Suite / CX (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Apply Now
Senior Researcher in Embedded Research for SAP Autonomous Suite / CX (f/m/d)

Date: 09/07/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you`ll build:

The Academic Partnerships organization at SAP partners with other SAP teams to provide the best services to foster strategic research collaborations between SAP and academia. The PhD Graduate Team is responsible for building the bridge between cutting-edge research and SAP functional teams. Our mission is to facilitate the application of research across SAP and contribute to SAP research strategy with interdisciplinary research activities.

Working together with the SAP Autonomous Suite CX team, focusing on customer satisfaction by increasing the predictability of the semester plans, you will bring perspectives and insights from large-scale agile and software development research to our product delivery planning, enhancing SAP’s strategic position in the Autonomous Suite and the innovation speed, and bridging the gap between industry and academia.

The Role:

In your daily work you will be bridging data science and engineering to turn development data into actionable insights — accelerating team flow, predictability, and customer satisfaction across SAP Commerce release cycles, collaborating with industry experts, researchers, and business stakeholders.

The position involves working within a highly motivated team of experts, driving innovation in a collaborative research environment , with close collaboration across lines of business and strong potential to influence future product directions and innovation at scale .

- Design and maintain a Commerce-wide engineering metrics framework to track delivery health and team performance
- Review metrics health at team, product, and portfolio level to surface bottlenecks and delivery risks early
- Embed retrospective learnings into process standards, creating a continuous improvement loop across Commerce teams
- Pilot AI-assisted tooling to improve planning accuracy, effort estimation, and workflow automation
- Share engineering excellence practices across squads and teams to accelerate adoption of predictable delivery patterns
- Bridge the gap between academic findings and industry
- Participate in interdisciplinary research activities with the PhD graduate team, supporting SAP’s research strategy
- Be an active part of research mentoring programs and the research community at SAP
- Collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders

What you bring:

- Advanced degree (PhD preferred) in Computer Science or Information Systems, with a research focus on large-scale agile development, engineering metrics, or communities of practice in software organizations
- Research background (publications preferred) in the field of innovation (incl. AI adoption) in software development models, scrum, agile, adoption or other development models
- Proven track record of applied industry-academic research related to agile contexts (conferences like IEEE CBI, publications preferred)
- Experience leading research projects and delivering data-driven recommendations in collaboration with industry partners
- Hands-on technical skills including data analysis, LLM and AI-assisted prototyping, and working with engineering telemetry data (e.g. Jira) to generate delivery insights, programming skills preferred (python, Java, JavaScript)
- Demonstrated ability to manage industry-academic partnerships and multi-stakeholder initiatives, and co-organizing large-scale events
- Ability to work on challenging research topics with a structured, scientific approach
- Sound understanding of SAP’s product strategy and the Autonomous Enterprise
- Experience integrating AI assistants in workflows, incl. quality assurance.
- Strong hands-on mindset and willingness to translate promising research direction into product functionality
- Strong collaboration skills and a team-oriented mindset
- Good written and verbal communication skills in English, German is a plus

Where you belong:

The Academic Partnership organization at SAP is the bridge connecting SAP and academia. We build collaborative, structured partnerships with academic institutions and encompass a wide range of activities and programs in regards of academic teaching, academic community management, and PhD talent management.

The PhD Graduate Team stands for embedding cutting-edge research into functional teams across SAP, bringing together interdisciplinary PhD talent in a research-like environment.

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
